preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of roads E must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two valid cities within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output 'YES' followed by E lines of road orientations; otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(road in roads for road in output_roads)
postconditions.description: The output roads must be a valid reorientation of the input roads.

postconditions.expression: all(road[0] != road[1] for road in output_roads)
postconditions.description: No road in the output can connect a city to itself.
